captions.detailed: A 3D-printable clip-on tumbler tag designed to slide over the rim of a drinking glass. It features an asymmetrical U-shaped profile with flat, angled outer walls and a uniform wall thickness. One leg of the clip is shorter than the other, allowing easy alignment, and the inner gap tapers slightly to provide a secure grip on varying glass thicknesses.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric, U-shaped clip-on tag for tumblers and drinking glasses. The user should be able to adjust parameters for maximum and minimum glass thickness, overall height, width, wall thickness, and optionally emboss a custom surface image onto one of the flat sides.
captions.factory: The design is constructed by first defining a 2D helper module 'halfed_outline' using the polygon primitive to draw one side of the clip's profile. Two instances of this polygon (one mirrored) are unioned together to form the complete U-shape profile, which is then extruded vertically using linear_extrude. Finally, a difference operation subtracts a scaled and rotated surface image loaded from an external file to emboss a custom symbol onto the outer wall.
